name: PhoneCheck — API on RapidAPI
description:
Verify phone numbers before they enter your system: PhoneCheck returns a validity verdict and line type for numbers worldwide — one at a time, or as a batch health report for a whole list.

What you get:
- A validity verdict per number, parsed and checked locally with the libphonenumber rule set — no third-party lookup latency
- Country, line type (mobile / landline / VoIP and more) and both international and national formats, plus a ready-to-use tel: link
- Batch health reports: send up to 100 numbers and get per-number results plus a summary of how clean the list is
- Consistent single and batch response formats, so one parser serves both paths

Key endpoints:
- GET /validate — validate a single phone number
- POST /validate — validate a single phone number (JSON body)
- POST /validate/batch — validate up to 100 numbers in one call, with a list-level summary

Batch / built for workflows:
Built for list hygiene and onboarding pipelines: the batch endpoint is the same one used in production list-cleaning workflows — one call in, a structured health report out. Single-number checks fit form validation, OTP enrollment screening and CRM data entry, all with zero upstream dependency: parsing runs locally, so responses stay fast and predictable.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
